question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**are**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is** 'The sign and symbols of Railways'.**
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**are**'.
 
• The given passage is in the **simple present tense** so the verb must be used in its **simple present form. **
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Passage:__** *There is always something so fascinating about trains and journeys. There **are** certain symbols and signages inside and outside of the train. The (2)_______ of most of them might not be known to everyone. (3)_________ you are a frequent traveller or not, you may have (4)_________ the letter X or a cross mark on the back of the last (5)________ of the train.*
